notes: Page breakdown: 16 world pickups, 6 General Store purchases, 19 random Fleet rewards (matches the 41 captured). Fleet pieces need the Fleet gate; page advises a manual save before accepting a fleet report and reloading if no art piece drops. All 41 give the Dilettante trophy. Region for fleet rows is Fleet plus the compass region of the Brig Piracy mission.
